home.h1: I'm Arnold Kengne, a software & DevOps engineer based in Douala, Cameroon.
bio: I design and build modern software architectures (microservices, Clean Architecture, hexagonal architecture) as well as large-scale web and mobile applications, from modeling to production.
Rigorous, results-driven and highly adaptable, I enjoy tackling complex technical challenges — feel free to reach out and say hello!
milestones: In 2026, I earned the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification.
In December 2025, I joined Sorawel as a software engineer to integrate and deploy the Odoo ERP.
Between 2023 and 2024, I built NOE, the mobile app for generating reports for KES Africa.
In 2023, I earned my engineering degree (design track) in computer engineering from ENSPD.
home.s1Text: When I'm not coding, you'll find me playing sports, reading — both technical and general literature — or playing video games. I also love traveling and listening to music.
home.s2Text: I was a web development trainer at PADESCE-WESCO in Douala. I taught the full software development cycle, from design to production, through hands-on workshops on HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and PHP.

cv.intro: Passionate, rigorous and results-driven software engineer with experience in modern software architectures, large-scale web and mobile applications, and DevOps and Cloud automation.

points: Integration, configuration and deployment of the Odoo ERP system tailored to the company's business needs.
Taught the full software development cycle, from theoretical design to production.
Ran hands-on workshops on core web technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and PHP.
Design and deployment of a SaaS platform for energy analysis and management (Django, Vue.js).
Architecture study and development of a job search platform (Node.js, React.js).
Design, analysis and implementation of a secure payment platform in Java.

experience.org: Kamer Engineering Solutions SARL · Douala, Cameroon
points: Development of RELEC_CUD, the mobile app for managing public lighting for the Douala Urban Community (CUD).
Design of a lifting inspection mobile app and a label printing/generation platform with QR codes.
Processing and analysis of technical data with Python scripts and Excel.
Technical assistance, maintenance and corporate IT support.
Development of an integrated management SaaS platform for pharmacies.
Refactoring and modernization of the Toolrad tool's code using Vuetify.
Modeling and design of a data warehouse with Talend Open Studio.
Annotation and labeling of datasets for AI model training (Google, Meta platforms, etc.).

experience.org: National Advanced School of Engineering of Douala (ENSPD)
points: Design of the ENSPD student enrollment web platform.
Creation of a QR code generation and verification system to secure student diplomas.
Design of the company's showcase website and proposal of an optimized network architecture.
Management and optimization of the company's visibility on its Facebook page.
